metadata.title: [Duplicate — see 10.5281/zenodo.24387073] Open-Source AI Agent Skills and MCP Servers Supply-Chain Security Audit Dataset (105,000+ Indexed Skills, 2026)
metadata.description:
What changed in this version (version 2, 22 November 2026). This record is a duplicate, created by mistake on 20 November 2026 when the same upload ran twice; version 1 held the same files as 10.5281/zenodo.24387074. Version 1's figures are wrong. It gave 105,000+ entries and a 97.8% never-audited share without a date (they describe the catalog around 10 June 2026), and its counts per group had been worked back from rounded percentages. This version removes those files and keeps only a note.

Use 10.5281/zenodo.24387073 instead ("Security-Grade Coverage in the Agent Skills Hub Catalog: June 2026 Snapshot (105,000+ Entries) and November 2026 Count"); that DOI always points to the newest version of the corrected record. Please do not cite this record.
